buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address The Head, Department of Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur Kharagpur Dist- Paschim Medinipur West Bengal-721302 . 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 7 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 4. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 5. Generic End User Certificate: Wherever Bidders are insisting for End User Certificate from the Buyer, same shall be provided in Buyer’s standard format only. 6. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 7. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid

8. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 9. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 10. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 11. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 12. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 13. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be as given in specifications from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 14. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 15. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 16. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bid-specific Manufacturer Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM’s signatory details, such as name, de

signation, address, e-mail ID, and Phone number, are required to be furnished along with the bid. 2. Bidders need to submit a Local content certificate with manufacturing plant details on OEM’s letter head duly signed & stamped. 3. The bidder must have a registered office & Service Center in the state of West Bengal and must have be en registered for a minimum period of three (3) years prior to the bid submission date. Documentary evide nce must be provided for each of the above. 4. Manufacturer should have valid PAN & GST Registration Certificate. 5. Any service/support call raised must be attended to within 24 hours by the bidder/OEM. Declaration to b e included. 6. Technical Feature & Brochure of the model quoted should be submitted along with the technical bid, and additionally, must be available on the OEM website (URL should be provided with the technical bid) for veri fication. 7. The Bidders are requested to submit the bids after the issue of clarifications, only considering the chang es made, if any. Bidders are totally responsible for incorporating/complying with the changes/amendments issued, if any, in their bid. 8. The malicious code certificate should be submitted on OEM letterhead. 9. In case an authorized agent submits a bid on behalf of a Principal/OEM, the same authorized agent shall not submit a bid on behalf of another Principal/OEM for the same item/product in the same tender. The bid der shall submit an appropriate declaration confirming compliance with this requirement. 10. The quoted product shall be covered by a minimum 5-year OEM warranty, along with 24×7 support an d Next Business Day (NBD) response. The warranty status of the product must be capable of verification th rough the OEM’s official support webpage using the Service Tag/System Serial Number. A 5-year OEM War ranty Certificate on OEM letterhead shall be submitted along with the bid. 11. The bidder shall submit a detailed Bill of Material (BOM) containing complete part numbers, including t he applicable OEM support part codes, on the OEM’s letterhead, duly signed and stamped by the authorize d representative. 12. The server should be certified with Microsoft Windows Server, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), SUSE L inux Enterprise Server (SLES), VMware ESXi, Canonical Ubuntu, Oracle Linux, Oracle VM, and Citrix. Releva nt certification should be submitted along with the bid. 13. A Technical Compliance Sheet duly issued on the OEM’s official letterhead shall be submitted along wit h the bid. 14. The integrated remote management system shall be Common Criteria certified to a minimum Evaluati on Assurance Level of EAL4+ (EAL4 augmented) or higher. The bidder shall submit a valid Common Criteri a certificate along with the relevant certification documentation as evidence of compliance. 15. At least 22TB secondary storage device is required to adequately handle extensive dataset storage re quirements. 16. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): An amount of Rs. 188000/- (Rupees One Lakh Eighty Eight Thousan d only) (refundable) in the form of Demand Draft (DD)/ Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR)/ Banker’s Cheque (BC) paid in favour of “INDIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY KHARAGPUR”, payable at Kharagpur must be submit ted with the bid. Any bid without EMD will summarily be rejected. No interest is payable on EMD. EMD will be refunded to the unsuccessful bidder after finalization of the bidding process stage by stage i.e. Technic al evaluation and Financial evaluation. The EMD of the vendor awarded the contract may be treated as par t of security deposit towards Performance Guarantee. EMD shall be forfeited if the selected vendor after a

ward of the contract fails to execute the same. Bidders has to upload scanned copy/proof of the Demand Draft (DD)/ Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR)/ Banker’ s Cheque (BC) aIong with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the buyer at below mentioned addr ess within 5 days of Bid End date/Bid Opening date. To The Assistant Registrar Stores and Purchase Section Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur Kharagpur – 721302. 17. Payment Terms: i. 90% payment of the total contract shall be made after receipt of stores in good orde r and condition, successful installation and demonstration, thereafter certification of yo ur bill by the concerned Head of the Department/ Centers/Schools/Units. ii. Balance 10% payment of the contract value may be released against submission of Performance Security to the tune of 3% of the total Contract Value or on completion of warranty period. 18. Performance Security: Performance Security may be submitted in the form of Demand Draft/ Fixed Deposit Receipt/ Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) from any of the commercial banks in India and paid i n favour of “INDIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY KHARAGPUR”, payable at Kharagpur to the tune of 3% of the total contract value. The PBG shall be valid for the period of warranty period plus 60 days. The p erformance security will be forfeited and credited to the procuring Entity’s account in the event of breach of contract by the contractor. The address for submission of hard copy of the Security Deposit is as follows : To The Assistant Registrar Stores and Purchase Section Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur Kharagpur – 721302. 19. Jurisdiction: All questions, disputes, or differences arising under, out of or in connection with the cont ract, if concluded, shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction at the place from which the acceptance of T ender is issued i.e. Jurisdiction of KOLKATA HIGH COURT. Acceptance to this effect is also necessary at the time of opening of Technical Bid. Important Note: Bidders should submit the following certificates as per Annexures i. Declaration of Local Content as per Annexure-I ii. Certificate for Land Border Sharing as per Annexure –II; and iii. Undertaking regarding Blacklisting/Non-debarment as per Annexure-III The above-mentioned Annexures are available through Google through Google Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DvPQWyOO_81KxfObLiWqaVtCyeSASWzp/view?usp=sharing .
